main.autoBanPlaceholder: Select champions to ban, in priority order
main.banPickHint: Set champion lists and options in the "Ban/Pick" page
main.displayTeammateScore: Show teammates score during Champion Selection
main.displayRecentTeammate: Show recent teammates during Champion Selection

banPick.lanePlaceholder: Not set, uses the global list

mode.globalHint: Always use the same list regardless of lane
mode.laneHint: Uses the list of your assigned lane. Falls back to the global list when that lane is not set or there is no lane assignment (custom, blind pick)

ban.ignoreTeammateIntentHint: When checked, bans the champion even if a teammate is hovering it. Otherwise it is skipped and the next one is banned
ban.hoverOnly: Select only, do not lock in
ban.hoverOnlyHint: Only selects the champion to ban so you can still change it or lock it in yourself. The game locks in the current selection when the timer runs out

pick.description: Hovers the champion you want to play only at the start of champion select, never after the ban phase begins (except for the fallback option below). Picked and teammate-hovered champions are skipped
pick.lockHint: When the auto hover succeeded this game, locks in with 1 second left on your pick turn (locks whatever is hovered at that moment, including your own change). If the hovered champion got banned, the next available one in the list is locked instead
pick.randomHint: When checked, a random champion from the pool is hovered each game. Otherwise the first available one in priority order
pick.rehover: Hover the next one when the hovered champion gets banned
pick.rehoverHint: When the auto-hovered champion gets banned (or picked by another player), hovers the next available one in the list. Never overrides a champion you chose yourself, and does nothing when the list has no other champion
pick.placeholder: Select champions to hover, in priority order
pick.poolPlaceholder: Select the champion pool, one is picked at random each game

runes.autoRecordHint: Records your runes when the game starts and adds the actual lane opponent afterwards, saved as a "lane + champion + opponent" profile. The latest game wins for the same matchup; pinned profiles are never overwritten. Only modes with assigned lanes are recorded
runes.autoApplyHint: After you lock in, guesses your lane opponent from the revealed enemy champions and applies the matching profile, falling back to "Any". It writes a temporary rune page (name starts with AutoRune) that takes no page slot and never touches your own pages
runes.emptyHint: No rune profiles yet. Star a recent match, add one manually, or play a few games with auto record on
runes.pin: Pin, never overwritten by auto record
runes.pinHint: Auto record will not overwrite a pinned profile for the same lane + champion + opponent
runes.pinnedHint: Pinned: auto record will not overwrite. Click to unpin
runes.unpinnedHint: Not pinned: auto record overwrites it next time you meet this matchup. Click to pin
runes.applyHint: Apply to the client now (creates a temporary rune page that takes no slot and never touches your own pages)
runes.applyFailed: Apply failed. Make sure the LoL client is running and the runes still exist
runes.runeDataFailed: Failed to load rune data, please check your network

champSelect.title: Champ select
champSelect.noProfile: No profile for this champion in this lane yet
champSelect.pickHint: Wrong guess? Click one to apply it; auto apply stops for this game

matches.hint: Only modes with assigned lanes are listed. Click the star to save that game's runes as a profile
matches.busyHint: Match history loading is paused during champ select and in game to avoid disturbing the client
matches.loadFailed: Failed to load match history. Make sure the LoL client is running
matches.starOverwrite: This matchup already has a different profile; saving overwrites it
matches.unstarConfirm: Remove the profile for this matchup?
matches.shardNotice: Match history has no stat shards. Pick the three shards at the bottom right, then save
matches.shardNoticePrefilled: Match history has no stat shards. Shards were prefilled from an existing profile of this champion; confirm or change them, then save

editor.importCurrent: Import current rune page from client
editor.importFailed: Import failed. Make sure the LoL client is running
editor.incomplete: Pick a champion and all 9 runes
editor.willOverwrite: A profile with the same lane + champion + opponent exists; saving overwrites it
